selector.root_resolution: Exactly one native hierarchy cell whose NAME equals root literally; retain resolved object handle.
selector.RAW: All primitive descendants with NAME beginning root plus literal slash, including GND/VCC.
selector.S: RAW excluding only REF_NAME GND/VCC. Keep clock/control/memory cells.
selector.P: Deduplicated actual physical/placeable objects from S. Resolve DSP split primitives through actual DSP48E2 ancestor, preserving raw-to-physical mapping. Retain memory and control classes, unresolved objects and reasons; do not inherit original E007 LUT/FF-only whitelist or Hadamard-only DSP assertion.
selector.literal_brackets: [1] is literal. Native broad discovery must be followed by literal string-prefix equality; no glob/regex-only membership acceptance.
selector.nonoverlap: Assert C01/C02 disjoint after resolution. Never form combined migration candidate.
selector.unknowns: Unknown mandatory identity or incomplete mapping blocks completeness/migratability claims; preserve unknown rows instead of dropping them.

membership.coverage: Native query counts, exported unique counts, duplicates/unknowns; current placement separate from modeled all-P-to-SLR2 assignment.

collection.resources: One exact unique hierarchy report_utilization -cells -slr per candidate. Native CLB/LUT/FF/BRAM36eq/URAM/DSP separate from raw primitives, sites/BEL slots and shared/exclusive sites. Reject recursive leaf tables as aggregate.

full_cut.scope: All nets attached to S primitive pins; merge all hierarchical segments with canonical-net/alias provenance, then enumerate every primitive leaf IN/OUT/INOUT endpoint and every top port, without top-N truncation.
full_cut.boundary: Canonical net has at least one S endpoint and at least one outside-S endpoint. Keep constants/controls/INOUT/top ports; retain internal attached nets for failure matching.

endpoint identity/cell or top port/REF/REF_PIN/DIRECTION/actual IS_CLOCK or explicit unavailable

timing.source: current unchanged physopt placement, query only
timing.acceptance: Complete boundary endpoint sets define query scope; preserve exact query sets/commands and actual returned paths with start/end/clocks/slack/delay. Empty/unavailable/error distinct. Cap16 is bounded, not exhaustive/signoff; no invented SLR2 timing.

collection.hotspot_failure: Intersect each RAW/S/P with original closed 10-NW deduplicated UNION, and full attached canonical nets with original exact 40 failure samples. Keep NET IDs, driver/load/inside/outside/SLR. Do not transfer parent-scope relation to child.
collection.original_UNION: Repair original R003 hotspot UNION connections with unchanged target/NW scope and segment provenance. Do not shrink to C01/C02. Preserve declared legacy IN/OUT coverage separately from new candidate complete INOUT/top cut.
collection.property_alignment: Batch cardinality guard; if compressed/sparse optional values misalign, query one object at a time and append exactly one value including empty. Record property/context/fallback/error. No filtering empties or silent misaligned zip. Empty required NAME/REF/DIRECTION fails; optional unknowns remain explicit.
collection.provenance: Exact bytes/SHA256 for sources/artifacts, immutable attempt archive, native closure codes, unchanged 144 production inputs/DCP/contracts, actual natural terminal/resources/PID-start/EDA lane under engineering supervision.

acceptance.execution: Scope/count closure, native query/stage outcomes and whole-attempt terminal/integrity reviewed separately; code0 alone insufficient.
